recognize_zh: 血液抹片中散在中至大型異常淋巴樣細胞（箭頭），核圓至不規則、染色質細緻、細胞質中等量淡藍且大多無明顯嗜天青顆粒；插圖 D 免疫染色見陽性細胞呈竇狀分布，配合年輕男性長期發燒，符合肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤周邊血液侵犯。
features: Medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei (arrows)
Moderately condensed to fine chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm, mostly without prominent azurophilic granules
Arrowheads mark smaller background nucleated cells for comparison
Panel D: immunostain with membranous positivity in cells distributed along sinusoidal spaces
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear contains scattered medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei, relatively fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm largely lacking azurophilic granules. These cells are distinct from the smaller background nucleated cells marked for comparison. The accompanying tissue immunostain shows positive cells arranged in a sinusoidal pattern. In a young man with prolonged fever, findings are consistent with peripheral blood involvement by hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma; flow cytometry for TCR gamma-delta, CD3+/CD4-/CD8-/CD56+ phenotype and isochromosome 7q should be pursued.

ddx.vs: T-LGL cells are small with abundant cytoplasm containing coarse azurophilic granules and usually express TCR alpha-beta with CD8/CD57.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia cells often contain azurophilic granules, lack surface CD3 and are EBV (EBER)-positive.
T-PLL cells have a prominent nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, are usually CD4-positive and carry TCL1A rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Reactive atypical lymphocytes (EBV or CMV infection)
ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are polymorphous with abundant cytoplasm hugging red cells and have a polyclonal T-cell receptor.

stain: Wright-Giemsa; IHC (panel D, marker not specified)
